transport: HTTPS JSON; main authority only; no public/client use; no SSE

all: x-p003-worker-token: HS256 JWT, iss=p003 aud=kidshub role=device, accountId matching server-authoritative target worker, required iat/exp
x-p003-listening-grant: bound eligibility JWT (all session routes)
authentication.worker_ready_exception: worker-ready requires worker JWT/service Bearer only; target agent/account resolved from server roster; headers only; no query-token fallback
authentication.secrets: AUTH_JWT_SECRET and LISTENING_GRANT_SECRET >=32 UTF8 bytes, no fallback; CUSTOM_LLM_API_KEY required
authentication.roster: LISTENING_WORKER_ACCOUNTS JSON object agent_name -> exact worker JWT accountId; no body-selected account

wire.unknown_fields: reject recursively; every ID is ASCII A-Za-z0-9_.:- as applicable; trim is not identity normalization

POST /worker-ready.response: {version,ok,ready,policy_revision,config_sha256,config:{scenes,tuning,limits}}; first ack null offers current config; ready needs approved release + fresh matching application ack; registered=false withdraws instance
rules: Original five required; optional sixth listening_voice_control_v1 only; no unknown/duplicate capabilities. Optional capability needs intersection of approved manifest and fresh worker ack; old five-capability builds stay compatible.
First request reserves an entry snapshot; authorized=false and expires=0 until request echoes applied_snapshot_sha256 exactly. Apply every field before retry with a NEW request_id.
Current policy_revision is latest config.revision; snapshot.revision/tuning stay frozen for this entry. Current gate/allowlist/scene still revoke it.
Once authorized, TTL <=15s and <=grant/session/device-credential/search cutoff/entry max_session deadline. Worker uses monotonic remaining duration, subtracts request elapsed and rejects <=0.
Every response is bound to request, session and entry/epoch; duplicates never extend original lease deadline. Lower mode_epoch or older listening entry seq rejected.
A new listening_id must have increasing trace:seq and previous entry must be closed. After expiry/revocation close old RTC session; no automatic chat.

POST /close.response: {version,request_id,closed:true}; authenticates session even when policy disabled; idempotent close cannot reopen entry

segments.text: 小熊和小兔分享了苹果。

rules: Contiguous ordered segment IDs, revisions >=1; raw <=12000 Unicode scalars; previous_summary <=1200. No user traits/persona read.
One content task per entry at a time. Model timeout 8s, result <=1200 chars. Missing source or excess output is failure, never silently truncate facts.

No server-side transcript persistence; echoes frozen coverage/base version/source hash. Worker must compare retained ticket/listening session/epoch/revisions then CAS apply; stale result is discarded, source not released.

request.recent: 小熊把最后一个苹果分给了小兔。
request.question: 你觉得呢？

rules: trigger button|voice_invitation|voice_command. voice_invitation remains story/sharing only; voice_command needs negotiated session capability listening_voice_control_v1 and frozen voice_invitation_enabled=true, including singing explicit called-name after-song phrase. Never relabel voice as button.
recent <=4000 chars, summary <=1200, question <=500. One request per epoch; cooldown enforced.
Text <=snapshot feedback_max_chars, generation budget <=min(8s, feedback_max_duration_sec); no tool/ordinary chat/onboarding/feedback-arm/style/long-term memory writes.
Current personality may be read without inject receipts. Lyrics/fiction never become autobiographical claims; no pitch/rhythm assessment.
Audio permission/turn/VAD/playout-duration gate remains Worker responsibility; HTTP200 is not permission to play or Android audibility evidence.

replay.request_ids: unique within authoritative session, same endpoint+body SHA required; never reuse an ID with modified epoch/snapshot
replay.content: in-flight=409 request_in_progress; same completed request returns short-lived RAM cache; cache missing/restart=409 request_spent; failures spent; never auto-regenerate same request
replay.recheck: credentials/registry/source cutoff/current gate/scene checked even for cached content; epoch cancellation/revocation while model running discards result

errors.envelope: {version:1,ok:false,error:{code:<stable>,retryable:<boolean>}}; no raw text, tokens, URLs or provider body

privacy.persistent: session/grant fingerprint, source expiry, ownership epoch, entry/snapshot/lease/request digest/terminal metadata only; no grant plaintext/story/lyrics/model text
privacy.content_cache: bounded RAM only, <=60s and invalidated by authorization or epoch change
privacy.logs: reason/count/latency only; no request bodies/headers/provider error bodies

readiness.manifest_env: LISTENING_RELEASE_MANIFEST_PATH (trusted operator evidence file; absent fails closed)
readiness.runtime: No manifest+fresh matching Worker/config ack => ready=false; truthful active/applied state only, no environment boolean override
readiness.config_ack: applied_config_sha256 equals snapshot hash of current global configuration; approved build + fresh matching ack needed. Entry lease separately acknowledges its frozen snapshot.

fixtures: p003-listening-http-v1.fixtures.json; synthetic values only; authorization/model doubles in offline tests do not certify production readiness
hashing: SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON: lexicographically sorted object keys recursively, array order retained, compact separators, Unicode unescaped. Snapshot sha256 hashes {revision,scenes,tuning,limits} without its sha256 field. source_sha256 hashes {base_summary_version,previous_summary,has_gap,segments}.

metadata.android_response: listening_contract contains version,capability,scenes,tuning,policy_revision,expires_at_ms; optional negotiated voice_control only; grant/account never handed to client

voice_control.rule: Only on three-way Android/approved Worker/fresh ack negotiation AND voice_invitation_enabled. Same optional object in signed listening metadata and client listening_contract; absent means unavailable. No grant/account sent to client.
